correctness.rationale: For all d>=2 and J_i>0, explicit Walsh diagonalization gives the exact least eigenvalue in the even/odd missing-coordinate sectors. Each eigenvalue-minimizing character is a binary spin configuration attaining the Rayleigh lower bound. Comparing the Fourier coefficients of the square of a Boolean affine function proves every binary vector in the minimum eigenspace is exactly one of the listed +/- characters, including at the transition. The packaged independent integer exhaustive spin enumeration for d<=4 and further exact spectral tests were replayed; these are checks, not a substitute for the all-d proof.

value.rationale: A complete infinite-family magnetic-ground-state theorem identifies the exact threshold and full configuration geometry under arbitrary positive anisotropy and either sign of antipodal coupling. The sharp parity-controlled relocation of unavoidable frustrated bonds and degeneracy jump from 2 to 2m to 2(m+1) constitute motivated structural properties of frustrated folded-hypercube networks, not an arbitrary finite slice. The uniform special case recovers a 16-vertex Clebsch-network benchmark, but is not the sole contribution.
